about.title: About the Author
about.subtitle: Meet Daniel Hernandez Rosales - Danihros
about.bio1: I am an independent writer passionate about creating fantasy worlds that transport readers to places where magic is real and adventures never end. Since I was a child, stories have been my refuge and my passion.
about.bio2: My goal is to write books that not only entertain but also inspire and leave a mark on the hearts of those who read them. Every story I create is an invitation to explore the unknown, face challenges, and discover the magic that exists in all of us.
about.bio3: When I'm not writing, I enjoy reading, exploring new places, and spending time with my family. I firmly believe in the power of stories to change lives and build bridges between people from all over the world.
about.sagaTitle: The Saga: The Lost Tales of Terra
about.sagaDesc1: "The Lost Tales of Terra" is my main saga, an epic fantasy series set in a world where ancient secrets await discovery and the fate of entire civilizations hangs in the balance.
about.sagaDesc2: In Terra, a kingdom forgotten by time, magical medallions hold ancestral powers and only those with pure hearts can unlock their true potential. Follow our heroes as they navigate betrayals, unexpected friendships, and battles that will define the future.
about.sagaAvailable: Several books available - More stories to come!
about.missionQuote: "To create stories that transcend the pages, that live in the imagination of readers and prove that magic exists in the very act of reading. I want each book to be a door to a world where everything is possible and where the reader can find a piece of themselves."

medallon.title: The Medallion of Destiny
medallon.tagline: The fate of Terra is in her hands
medallon.synopsis: In a world where magic was forgotten, an ancient medallion awakens ancestral powers. When Elara discovers the artifact in the ruins of a lost temple, her life changes forever. Now she must face dark forces seeking the medallion and uncover the truth about her own lineage.

sombras.title: Shadows of the Past
sombras.synopsis: Shadows hold secrets that some prefer to forget. When the past threatens to destroy the present, only those brave enough to face their deepest fears can save what they love.

luvis.title: Luvis: Story of a Brave Flower
luvis.tagline: The adventure of a little heroine
luvis.synopsis: A little flower named Luvis dreams of seeing the world beyond the garden where she was born. With courage and determination, she embarks on a magical journey that will teach her that true bravery comes from the heart. An enchanting story for readers of all ages.
